connect.hint: Enter the Falcon server URL, usually https://… behind a reverse proxy; enter the access password after opening it.
connect.badUrl: The address must start with http:// or https:// and include a hostname
connect.deleteBody: Only the saved connection profile will be removed. The current connection and server data will not be affected.
connect.plaintextBody: %{url} is not a loopback address and has no TLS: the access password and all terminal content will travel over the network in plaintext. Use https:// behind a reverse proxy instead.
